id.description: The ID to utilize for this form. Readonly.

description.description: The description of this form's purpose.

id.description: The id used to reference this value

type.description: The python literal type for the given object. Defaults to 'any'. May define the variable could be multiple types such as 'str | None'

value.description: The starting value for the variable. May get the values from existing objects such as '{article.title}'.

id.description: The id for the input (literally the `id="[value]"` of an HTML tag)

name.description: The name for the input (literally the `name="[value]"` of an HTML tag)

type.description: The type of input which the user is expected to enter

enum.description: A list of restricted input choices

helpText.description: The help text for the input

value.description: Allows the user to set a value for the input, useful for hidden variables use in logic sections.

defaultValue.description: The default value for the input if the user does not enter one

placeholderValue.description: The placeholder value for the user to show an example of what is required for the input

required.description: True if the input requires the user to enter some value, false otherwise.

hidden.description: True if the input is hidden or not rendered on the page, false otherwise.

variableToSaveAs.description: The name of the variable to save as, may have dots in name such as "article.title" to represent saving the title of an article object.

logic.description: Conditional logic which allows the user to specify if any of the previous input parameters change based upon conditional logic

value.description: Parameters for the rule (e.g., minimum value, regex pattern)

error.description: Custom error message for when the validation fails

condition.description: Optional condition for when the validation should apply
